fields.title: 📖 Uṣūl of the Manhaj: Not Every Beautiful Deed Is Sunnah
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“Ibn Masʿūd said to people who wanted good: ‘How many want good but do not attain it.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A good intention does not save an innovation. The scale is not feeling, but the Sunnah and transmission.

immutable.source: 📝 ad-Dārimī, as-Sunan, Muqaddimah, Bāb: fī Karāhiyat Akhdh ar-Raʾy.
